message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever house rule you set). Points are earned by being the first to finish a round and by collecting the cards left in opponents’ hands. | | **Players** | 2–10 (standard deck). | | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue) × 25 cards each (one 0, two 1–9, two “Skip”, two “Reverse”, two “Draw Two”) + 4 “Wild” + 4 “Wild Draw Four”. | | **Setup** | • Shuffle the deck.
• Deal 7 cards to each player.
• Place the remaining cards face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s a special card, apply its effect immediately (e.g., if it’s a “Draw Two”, the first player draws two cards and loses their turn). | | **Turn Order** | Players sit in a circle. The first player is the one to the left of the dealer. Turn order moves clockwise unless a “Reverse” card changes direction. | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the color or the number/symbol of the top card on the discard pile. If you have a Wild card, you can play it at any time and choose the new color. | | **Special Cards** | 1. **Skip** – Next player loses their turn.
2. **Reverse** – Reverses play direction.
3. **Draw Two** – Next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
4. **Wild** – You choose the new color.
5. **Wild Draw Four** – You choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you risk a challenge.) | | **Drawing** | If you cannot play a card, you must draw one from the draw pile. If that card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise your turn ends. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | The round ends when a player discards their last card. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands: numbers = face value, Skip/Reverse/Draw Two = 20, Wild/Wild Draw Four = 50. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. First player to reach the target score (usually 500) wins the game. | | **House Variations** | • **No “Wild Draw Four” challenge** – play it anytime.
• **“Draw Two” challenge** – similar to Wild Draw Four.
• **“Skip” on the first card** – skip the first player.
• **“Reverse” on the first card** – reverse direction but still start with the first player. | --- ### Quick Play‑through Example 1. **Deal**: 7 cards each. 2. **Start**: Flip top card – say it’s a Red 7. 3. **Player 1**: Has a Red 3 → plays it. 4. **Player 2**: Has a Yellow 3 → plays it. 5. **Player 3**: Has a “Draw Two” → plays it. Player 4 draws two cards and skips. 6. **Player 5**: Plays a Wild → chooses Blue. 7. **Player 6**: Has a Blue 9 → plays it. 8. … Continue until someone discards their last card. --- ### Tips & Strategy - **Keep a balanced hand** – try to hold a mix of colors to avoid being stuck. - **Use Wilds wisely** – save them for when you’re low on cards or to force a draw. - **Watch opponents** – if someone is close to “UNO”, be ready to call them out. - **Plan for “Reverse”** – it can change the flow of the game, especially in 2‑player games where it becomes a “Skip”. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
